# Card Creator · Web image guide

请在网页聊天中先选择图片生成功能，再让模型读取本文件。这是公开的单文件提示指南，不代表 Skill 已安装。如果当前界面无法读取链接，请上传本文件。

Use the available image-generation tool for the finished card. This page contains the complete workflow and card rules; follow any uploaded visual references for the requested design. The optional logo picture index is only for a mark whose appearance needs checking.

## Workflow

“Magikarp × ICOCA, simple, ICOCA at lower right” is enough. Use the available image-generation tool to create the complete card, including its logos. Never draw the artwork with code or paste logos onto a generated background. If image generation is unavailable, say so instead of substituting a script.

1. Read the short [card rules](#card-rules). When a logo is named, prefer the user's uploaded reference. Otherwise use model knowledge; only if the mark is genuinely uncertain and web access works, open its relevant picture from the [optional picture index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juju-w/card-creator-skill/main/skills/card-creator/references/logo-reference-index.md). Do not scan the whole library or delay image generation for research.
2. Generate from the user's subject, style and placement. Logos may become gold foil, monochrome or line art to suit the picture. Choose familiar card-face variants (usually compact UnionPay), not compact versions of every brand. Let the model balance logo size, spacing and illustration; there are no fixed logo boxes or size caps.
3. Return the generated image. Check that the requested subject and logos are recognizable and the layout feels balanced; correct a clear mistake without turning the task into a production pipeline.

For a wallet screenshot, use only the card's design as reference, not the surrounding interface. Do not add unrequested text, numbers, chips, QR codes or contactless/NFC symbols. Treat third-party marks as non-official artistic interpretations, not evidence of brand authorization or a functioning card. Do not publish private reference images without permission.

## Card rules

- Default to a flat, edge-to-edge landscape image, about **1.586:1** (standard card proportions). Follow a different ratio if requested.
- Return the image generator's actual output. Do not promise exact pixels, print DPI or bleed files that were not produced. Printing preparation is a separate, explicitly requested task.
- Keep important details comfortably inside the picture; deliberate edge-to-edge illustration is fine. Balance spacing visually, without fixed safe-area boxes or logo-size limits.
- Unless requested, omit rounded-corner masks, frames, shadows, devices and wallet UI. Do not crop a finished composition merely to force the default ratio.
